query:
SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM chat_message_events e
            JOIN chat_messages m
              ON m.id = e.message_id AND m.created_at = e.message_created_at
            WHERE e.room_id = $1
              AND e.sequence > $2
              AND e.kind = $3
              AND m.status <> $4
              AND (m.user_id IS NULL OR m.user_id <> $5)
